_comment: A group with `includeDependenciesRecursively: false` takes `b.js` and leaves its dependency `indicator.js` in the chunk of the dynamic entry `b.js`. That chunk exports `indicator` to the group chunk, so `import()` of `b.js` gives an extra key, as the manual code splitting guide documents. The check for dynamic entry namespaces covers only a chunk that holds its entry module, so the debug assertion skips this chunk. Rolldown sets `allow-extension` for this option combination when the config does not set it.
